bugs.title: run_llama_bench crashes on every invocation
bugs.description: The command never requests JSON output, so llama-bench emits markdown. json.loads(out) runs outside the try block, causing an uncaught JSONDecodeError that kills --llama-bench mode entirely.

bugs.title: Mid-run server death stamps wrong hash on failed rows
bugs.description: In benchmark_model, the crash handler uses config_hash=chashes[pid] (the prompt where death was noticed) for all remaining prompts pid2, while correctly setting prompt_id=pid2. This produces rows where config_hash and prompt_id are inconsistent.

bugs.title: Literal backslash-n in build_padded contaminates every padded prompt
bugs.description: The string '\\n' is two characters (backslash + n), not a newline. Every padded benchmark prompt has this artifact glued between filler and instruction, unlike the rest of the file which uses real newlines.

bugs.title: --history silently drops --json flag
bugs.description: report(db, history=True, model=...) never passes as_json=args.json, so requesting JSON output while in history mode silently falls back to table format.

bugs.title: ensure_columns strips ts default during ALTER, causing NULL timestamps on migrated DBs
bugs.description: d.split(' DEFAULT (')[0] reduces ts to bare TEXT, but insert_run never supplies ts. On v2-A/v2-B tables upgraded via ADD COLUMN, every subsequently inserted row has ts IS NULL.

bugs.title: cfg['extra'] forwarded verbatim to llama-bench and llama-perplexity
bugs.description: Server-only flags like --spec-type ngram-mod and --reasoning auto are not accepted by those tools, causing --llama-bench to error for lfm-8b and --ppl to silently yield no comparison.
bugs.fix: Split into extra_server vs extra_common or filter per tool

provenance_gaps.title: --lock-clocks and --repeats absent from config_hash
provenance_gaps.description: A locked-clock run will has_ok-match an unlocked run and be skipped. Median-of-1 and median-of-3 share a hash despite llama-bench's extra_key including repeats.

provenance_gaps.title: flags field overclaims for non-harness modes
provenance_gaps.description: Every hash embeds 'ngl99,fa-on,jinja,no-context-shift,t8,tb16' but run_ppl passes none of these, llama-bench never sees t/tb/jinja/no-context-shift, and fill/max_tokens leak into lb/ppl hashes.

provenance_gaps.title: Clock-lock state not in config_hash
provenance_gaps.description: Measure once unlocked, and every later --run --lock-clocks skips all cells as already measured. gpu_clock_sm lets you see the regime after the fact but skip logic cannot distinguish them.
provenance_gaps.fix: Add 'clocks': args.lock_clocks to the hash key

provenance_gaps.title: Needle gate partially self-defeating
provenance_gaps.description: NEEDLE_WORDS ∩ _VOCAB = {vector, tundra}. Two of ten secrets are partially camouflaged by filler distractors, and make_secret() uses unseeded global random so misses aren't reproducible.
provenance_gaps.fix: Disjoint the two lists and/or seed the RNG

additional_issues.title: Missing binaries crash the whole run
additional_issues.description: Model files are existence-checked; binaries aren't. Popen sits before the try block, so a missing llama-server raises FileNotFoundError past the finally (leaking log) and aborts remaining models.

additional_issues.title: chat() has no total deadline
additional_issues.description: urlopen(timeout=...) is per-read; a stalled stream hangs forever. With default --timeout 600, a 131k-ctx padded prompt at ~200 t/s pp alone exceeds the budget.

additional_issues.title: Reasoning model distorts TTFT/tg fallback
additional_issues.description: Deltas land in reasoning_content, so TTFT measures first visible content and wall-clock tg fallback undercounts if server timings are absent.

additional_issues.title: Needle secret not recorded in notes
additional_issues.description: Only pass/fail is stored; stashing the secret in notes would make misses auditable.

additional_issues.title: ClockLock resets on exception but not SIGKILL
additional_issues.description: The help text 'ALWAYS reset on exit' oversells the guarantee. Also locks only core clock, not memory clock.

additional_issues.title: File naming irony
additional_issues.description: File is benchmark_v2.py but docstring says v3.
